summary.text: One of the forty-four suitors from Zacynthus in Apollodorus' island catalogue — distinct from Stratius son of Nestor at Pylos and from Apollodorus' Stratichus spelling for the same Pyliad prince.

story.text: Apollodorus names Stratius among the wooers assigned to Zacynthus, listed after Thadytius in Epitome 7.29 — before the repeated Phrenius and Indius entries and Daesenor in the same roll.
